Hi last time i tried using paradedb my pg cluster stopped replicating (I am fine with search queries being run on only the primary). Had to create my own fork.

I feel like there is an excessive push towards enterprise plans even before people are able to integrate pg_search.

Regardless I appreciate the work your team has been doing related to dev exp like native drizzle orm support and bringing in vectors along side bm25 search. Complete pg search is looking promising by the day!
this is not solving Postgres Count problem, Use another DB is not solving the problem.
